lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Cadet, good to see you!
Who is this?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: It's me, Moran!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: The boss of the Peony Association!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I've been like an older sister to you

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: for a while now.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Are you trying to hurt my feelings or something?
I was just pulling your leg.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Jeez... I thought you were actually being serious for a second.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I was about to go out and hunt you down.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: it's nice contacting you privately.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: That way nobody else will bother us.
You mean Rosanna?
You mean Sakura?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Yeah, her and Sakura.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Yeah, her and Rosanna.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Those two always have a pointed barb for me.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Ah!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Did you know that we're all part of the same squad?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Rosanna is the boss of Hedonia,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Sakura is the boss of Seimeikai,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: and I'm the boss of the Peony Association.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: The three of us together make up the Underworld Queen Squad.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: At the Peony Association,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: our members value loyalty above all else.
I presume that as their leader, you feel the same way?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: An assassin is nothing without loyalty.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: We live and die by that creed.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What do you think?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I came up with the slogan myself.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Isn't it cool?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Actually,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: now that I think of it,

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: it's about time I get back to work.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I'll contact you later, Cadet.
